name: deck-reader
title_zh: 按融资阶段逐格核对路演PPT的查漏员
tagline_zh: 创始人发来一版deck，你不再凭感觉说“这里缺市场验证”。它按pre-seed/seed两套格子逐项打钩。
tagline_en: Founder drops a deck; you stop guessing what's missing. It checks every box against pre-seed or seed grids and.
desc_en: Use when the user runs /deck-reader with a path to a pitch deck PDF (and, at seed, the annexes the founder sent) and wants the deck-completeness report written next to it. One grid per stage (pre-seed, seed); the deck's announced stage picks the grid. Never a verdict.
why_zh: 把“完整”拆成可勾选的格子，阶段不同格子不同；只报事实不评好坏，逼你自己看漏了哪一格。
why_en: Completeness becomes a checklist that changes with the announced stage. It reports only what's absent, never judges quality—so.
limit_zh: 只认PDF格式的路演材料，且必须用/deck-reader命令指定路径；只按pre-seed和seed两套网格核对。
limit_en: PDF pitch decks only, via /deck-reader with a path; covers pre-seed and seed grids exclusively; outputs a gap report beside the file, no advice.
title_en: A stage-aware completeness checker for pitch deck PDFs
